title: GTP: Add length verification for the payload size
description:
Add bogus error messages when GTP and GTPv1-C payload length is malformed, either too small or too big:

![image](/uploads/f0df7e741a725daa19a82cb6c48e6bf6/image.png){width=821 height=187}

---
